description: This file contains implementations for serialization, surrogate conversion, and deep copying of ConcurrentQueue<T> in the Orleans framework. It includes the ConcurrentQueueCodec class, a surrogate struct, and a copier class, all geared towards efficient serialization and copying of concurrent queue data structures.

classes.name: ConcurrentQueueCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ConcurrentQueue<T> utilizing serialization surrogates.

classes.name: ConcurrentQueueSurrogate<T>
classes.description: A surrogate structure used during serialization to hold queue values.

classes.name: ConcurrentQueueCopier<T>
classes.description: A deep copier implementation for ConcurrentQueue<T> enabling object cloning.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate representation back into a ConcurrentQueue<T>.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a ConcurrentQueue<T> into its surrogate representation.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a source ConcurrentQueue<T>.

methods.name: DeepCopy (overloaded)
methods.description: Copies elements from one ConcurrentQueue<T> to another.
